record.original_question: Decide whether every numerical semigroup S satisfies Wilf's conjectured inequality e(S)g(S) <= (e(S) - 1)(F(S) + 1), where e(S) is the embedding dimension, g(S) is the genus, and F(S) is the Frobenius number.

evidence.quote: Wilf in [66] conjectures that if S is a numerical semigroup, then e(S)g(S) <= (e(S) - 1)(F(S) + 1).
Some families of numerical semigroups for which it is known that the conjecture is true are collected in [16]. Other such families can be seen in [23, 59]. The general case remains open.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A numerical semigroup is a subset S of the non-negative integers that contains 0, is closed under addition, and has finite complement in the non-negative integers. For such an S, define:
- the Frobenius number F(S) as the largest integer not in S;
- the genus g(S) as the cardinality of the set of non-negative integers not in S;
- the embedding dimension e(S) as the cardinality of the minimal set of generators of S (equivalently, |(S \ {0}) \ ((S \ {0}) + (S \ {0}))|).

Decide whether the inequality
    e(S) · g(S) ≤ (e(S) − 1) · (F(S) + 1)
holds for every numerical semigroup S.
artifact.status_search_result: Wilf's conjecture, posed in 1978, remains open in general as of 2024–2025. It has been verified computationally for all numerical semigroups up to genus 100 (verification published October 2024) and proved for several large families (e.g., semigroups with sufficiently large maximum primitive, gluings, second-level semigroups), but no general proof or counterexample is known.

status_evidence.title: Recent trends IV: From a naive question to a long-standing conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: In 1978, Wilf posed the question... This intriguing question is nowadays known as Wilf's conjecture. The conjecture is still open in general.
status_evidence.claim: Wilf's conjecture is still open in general as of 2024.

status_evidence.title: On counting numerical semigroups by maximum primitive and Wilf's conjecture
status_evidence.snippet: Almost all numerical semigroups with large enough maximum primitive satisfy Wilf's conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Recent partial progress; conjecture not yet settled in full generality.

status_evidence.title: Wilf Inequality is preserved under Gluing of Semigroups
status_evidence.snippet: The Wilf inequality is preserved under gluing of numerical semigroups.
status_evidence.claim: Additional partial results, but the general case remains open.
